launch.keepout: band strands run forward from the slot's side openings, clear of the head
launch.kinematics: a forward band pull drives the loop up the slot's aft (bearing) face into the seat (the slot top or a plug's rounded underside); when the model outruns the band the loop slides down that face and out of the mouth. The recessed form of a rear-raked hook; claude-07's D1 should check it.
launch.plugs: one part per (slot, lower offset); the top offset is the bare slot top; plug clearance 0.1 mm a side (assumed); retain with tape or a drop of glue
launch.record_per_flight: slot x, seat offset (plug id), ballast, pelvic key

slot.across: full body width (band loop lies across the body)
